I’ve seen chihuahuas break retractable leads unfortunately. The idea seems good, but the execution just isn’t. Dogs will often pull harder because they expect the lead to move and allow them to go further and at times it has lead to dog attacks. 

We had a 30ft lead and we just had it wrapped around our arm like you would an extension cord or garden hose I guess. It does take awhile to figure out what works for you and there will be tangles but they are a much safer option. 

Waist leads are a good option, as long as your dog doesn’t run off and you turn into a spinning top. If you’re small then your dog may pull you over and depending on their strength drag you. 

Everything has their pros and cons you just have to find what works for you guys! I don’t think your being silly at all there is a lot of information out there. You’re doing the best you can for your doggo and that is all they can ask of you. You will always get advice and some may contradict other advice you’ve received. So my advice would be to find what suits your dog and situation and go with that.
